name: Tsue no Otoko
source:
An assassin attempting to hunt down [url=/c73545]Hitomi Osawa[/url] soon after she hands off the ransom money.

[spoiler]His identity is Kyozo Tateno, a detective at the Shibuya Central Police Station. [url=/c73541]Kano[/url] looks up to Tateno and has based his detective "Dick Diary" based on the various dictums Tateno provides.

Tateno is a childhood friend of Achi's parents, having been in love with [url=/c129946]Kotone[/url] even long after her death. [url=/c74743]Daisuke[/url] asked Tateno to kill Hitomi so that her heart could be transplanted into their daughter, [url=/c87869]Suzune[/url], and save her from her terminal heart condition.[/spoiler]
